definitions.explanation: As one thought, confirms expectations or decisions.

examples.japanese: やっぱり{日本|にほん}がいい。

notes:
やっぱり confirms expectations or expresses "after all".

VARIATIONS:
- やっぱり: common spoken form
- やはり: formal/written form
- やっぱ: casual abbreviation

MEANINGS:
1. As expected: やっぱりそうだった (it was as I thought)
2. After all (reversal): やっぱり{行|い}かない (not going after all)
3. Still/anyway: やっぱり{日本|にほん}がいい (Japan is still best)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- やっぱり{思|おも}った{通|とお}り (just as I thought)
- やっぱり{無理|むり}だ (it's impossible after all)
